Verified on File:Artorias - Heavy Slam.gif: 605902 bytes GIF89a 210x118, vs 220726-byte animated WebP on every other variant. ACQUISITION-CRITIQUE-R1's finding 'the true GIF bytes are not obtainable' is FALSE and should be corrected. `/revision/latest?format=original` also works. Bare path, ?cb=, Accept: image/gif, vignette.wikia host, browser UA -> all still WebP.
